# cb:b362 · user-provenance-vs-artifact-sync-divergence

> When a writable field carries a user-authored provenance entry (source prefix user: or manual:) and a subsequent sync pass ingests an artifact (email, sheet, calendar) that disagrees, a pure overlay policy (user-wins) silently hides the contradiction and a pure artifact-wins policy silently discards the user edit. Both failure modes are invisible without explicit conflict detection at write time.

**Type:** attestation · **Kind:** observation · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active

## Evidence

1. **2026-04-20** - While planning a travel extension, the user relayed a verbal message and asked how the derived need should be recorded. Investigation confirmed the provenance schema already supports user-authored attestations, but no policy defined what happens when a later artifact-sourced sync disagrees with a user-provenance entry on the same field.
